description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2024: Large-Scale Mobile Shakers and Associated Instrumentation for Dynamic Field Studies of Geotechnical and Structural Systems is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Kenneth Stokoe, University of Texas at Austin (utexas.edu). The poster for the NHERI Summit explains the NHERI@UTexas facility and highlights six example projects. The three main research areas of NHERI@UTexas are (1) Developing 2D/3D subsurface geotechnical imaging for deeper, more accurate, and higher-resolution analyses, (2) Characterizing the nonlinear dynamic response and liquefaction resistance of complex geomaterials in situ, and (3) Creating rapid ... Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-knwt-b346. Keywords: NHERI@UTexas, Large-Scale Mobile Shaker. Published 2024-06-20. Facility named: Mobile Field Shakers - University of Texas at Austin. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
